definition: play as one of my strongest healing moves, and why aiming at the healing ends it

settled:
Play is one of the most effective things I have for healing my nervous system. It is enormously useful, and that is no exception to my rule that a thing has to be useful. It is the one way through that rule.

The benefit only arrives while I am doing the thing as the thing. The instant I reach for the healing, the for flips, the purpose takes the room, and the yield stops. I cannot pull the benefit toward me. I can only do the thing and let the benefit happen behind my back.

Two decades of demoting every activity to a means is the scar tissue sitting in that doorway. I am not waiting for it to clear. I am filing away at it deliberately, because the thing with the highest healing yield is held shut by the exact reflex it would heal.

title: Why Play Is Medicine I Cannot Reach For
